Definition
[Train track] 1. Definitions 8.9.1\group train tracksSource: thurston:page-0220 A train track on a differentiable surface is a smoothly embedded branched one-complex whose branches meet at switches with common tangent directions; its complementary regions satisfy the standard negative-Euler-characteristic conditions. A lamination is carried when it lies in the associated foliated neighborhood and follows its branch foliation.
